summary: Completed comprehensive testing of TunePulse music streaming app. Backend APIs are 95% functional with minor album creation issue. Frontend has critical Select component errors preventing artist upload functionality.

critical_bugs.issue: Album creation endpoint expects form data but documentation suggests JSON. Returns 422 validation error.
critical_bugs.impact: Artists cannot create albums through API

ui_bugs.issue: React Select.Item components have empty value props causing runtime errors

integration_issues.issue: Upload music page fails to load due to Select component errors

action_item_for_main_agent: Fix Select component implementation in UploadMusic.js - ensure all SelectItem components have non-empty value props. Also fix album creation API to properly handle form data.
